_comment: End-to-end fixture for the Duet3 6HC (SAME70Q20B) in deterministic tick mode. spi_tmc enables the renode_hooks TMC SPI chain responder (CPU-PC hook on spidev_transfer) for the four TMC5160s on the shared usart1 SPI daisy-chain. analog_in feeds the adc_scaled reference + thermistor channels on the SAME70 AFEC (afec_stub.py). SAME70 AFEC channels are AFEC1-LOCAL (global chan - 12; see src/atsam/sam4e_afec.c afec_pins[]): vref_pin PC0 = global 21 -> local 9, vssa_pin PC13 = global 13 -> local 1, bed PC15 = global 14 -> local 2, extruder PC29 = global 16 -> local 4. vref high / vssa low so (vref - vssa) != 0 (no ZeroDivisionError in adc_scaled), and the thermistor channels at ~0.95 of the scaled range read ~26 C - inside the bed [0,130] / extruder [0,285] ranges.
